title: U.S. House · Virginia's 6th District
area: Western and central Virginia's Shenandoah Valley and Roanoke region, including Winchester, Harrisonburg, Staunton, Lexington, Roanoke and Botetourt County.

context.text: Both primaries were canceled after only one candidate qualified for each ballot line. On the Democratic side, Wendy Gooditis, Ken Mitchell, Hugh Murray and Pete Barlow withdrew or were disqualified, leaving Beth Macy unopposed for the nomination. Incumbent Benjamin Lee Cline advanced unopposed on the Republican line. Cook Political Report, Decision Desk, Inside Elections and Sabato's Crystal Ball all rate the race Solid/Safe Republican as of September 22, 2026.

candidates.name: Benjamin Lee Cline
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the Republican primary unopposed after the primary was canceled.

positions.summary: His campaign site says life has value from conception and that he champions pro-life legislation to protect the unborn.
positions.quote: I have always been a champion of pro-life legislation that protects our God-given right to life, and I’ll never stop fighting for the unborn.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on the Judiciary.
Serves on the House Committee on Appropriations.
Serves on the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.
Serves on the House Committee on the Budget.

candidates.name: Beth Macy
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced from the Democratic primary unopposed after other candidates withdrew and the primary was canceled.

priorities.text: Making life affordable for working families and expanding access to health and mental health care.

Regulating data centers and artificial intelligence, including a proposed nationwide moratorium on new data centers until energy, environmental, cost and workforce concerns are addressed, and requiring Big Tech to pay the full costs of data-center construction and energy/water use.
priorities.quote: A nationwide moratorium on new data centers should be enforced until energy, environmental, cost, workforce and other citizens' concerns are addressed through legislation.

priorities.text: Protecting Social Security, Medicare and veterans' benefits from privatization, and raising the cap on Social Security payroll taxes so higher earners pay more into the system.

positions.summary: Says Congress should raise the cap on Social Security payroll taxes so wealthier earners pay a larger share.

Her campaign priorities page calls healthcare a human right, criticizes the expiration of ACA subsidies and the coming loss of Medicaid coverage, and says Congress should stop attempts to privatize Medicare.
Calls for ending tariffs, saying they act as a tax on purchased goods and hurt farmers by shutting them out of overseas markets and raising equipment costs.
Her campaign priorities page criticizes current ICE enforcement, calls for legal pathways to permanent status or citizenship, and says ICE must be stopped from hurting neighbors.
positions.quote: We must stop ICE from hurting our neighbors.

positions.summary: Her campaign priorities page says Congress should create incentives for state and local governments to enact housing reforms, including zoning reform.
positions.quote: Congress should create incentives for state and local governments to enact reforms that pave the way for more affordable housing, including zoning reform.

researchNotes: Cline did not complete Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey and his campaign site (bencline.com) returned a bot-check page, so his current-cycle priorities in his own words could not be verified; the record items reflect his official committee assignments only.
